comment: An id is not required in the data but jargon requires for blue class which won't redefine credentialSubject

domainIncludes.comment: The physical site (eg farm or factory) where the product or materials was produced. Including the facility sustainability performance record.
A conformity claim about the facility against a specific standard or regulation.
